commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a project and VS Code configuration

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Copy an Odin project or translate compiler commands

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build an executable, library or other artifact

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check a project without building an artifact

commands.name: vet
commands.description: Check conventions and optionally apply corrections

commands.name: strip-semicolon
commands.description: Remove unnecessary semicolons from project sources

commands.name: ast
commands.description: Print the parsed syntax tree as JSON

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show standard or full command help

sections.text:
Project migration: migrate
  thor migrate <directory>      Copy an Odin project into ./<directory-name>
  --output-dir PATH            Parent directory receiving <directory-name>
                               Default current directory
  --command 'odin ...'         Translate an invocation (repeatable)
                               Without a directory, prints commands only
  --dry-run                    Build-validate the copy, then discard it
  --odin PATH                  Select the Odin compiler
  -define:NAME=VALUE           Match the original build configuration
  -collection:NAME=PATH        Resolve custom packages relative to the source project
  -target:OS_ARCH              Validate the selected native target

Compiler and diagnostics: transpile, check, build, run, test, vet, publish, ast
  --odin PATH                  Select the Odin compiler (also THOR_ODIN)
  --diagnostic-format FORMAT   Choose diagnostic output
                                 text    Human-readable messages (default)
                                 json    Structured messages on stderr
  --raw-diagnostics            Show original Odin diagnostics
  --overlay PATH               Read editor source replacements from a JSON file

Generated files: transpile, check, build, run, test, vet, publish, doc, strip-semicolon
  --output-dir PATH            Choose the generated Odin/build directory
                               Default .thor-rust-build/<source> in the working directory
  --source-maps                Keep source maps with generated Odin files
                               Transpile and debug builds keep maps automatically

Caching: transpile, check, build, run, test, vet, publish, ast, doc, strip-semicolon
  --cache-dir PATH             Choose the parser and compile-time result cache
                               Default .thor-cache beside the entry package
  --no-cache                   Bypass parser and compile-time result caches
  --clear-cache                Clear managed parser and evaluation entries first

Compile-time execution: transpile, check, build, run, test, vet, publish, doc, strip-semicolon
  --comptime MODE              Select Thor compile-time execution policy
                               required: explicit/necessary evaluation only
                               normal: automatic fn evaluation (default)
                               aggressive: also fold eligible value-returning procs
                               override: aggressive, ignoring #runtime barriers
  --run-timeout SEC            Limit each compile-time execution in seconds
                               0 means unlimited (default)
  --cache-report               Print compile-time cache counters as JSON

Thor conventions: check, build, run, test, vet, publish
  --vet[=CHECKS]               Check immutable,pure,unused,semicolon (default all)
                                 immutable    Suggest immutable declarations
                                 pure         Suggest eligible procs become fn
                                 unused       Report unused bindings, imports, types and procs
                                 semicolon    Report unnecessary semicolons
                               Select multiple checks with commas
                               thor vet enables all four checks by default
                               Findings are errors for build; warnings otherwise

Corrections: vet only
  --apply                      Apply verified corrections automatically
  --ask                        Preview corrections and ask before applying
                               Choose one of --apply or --ask

Artifact options: build, run, test, publish
  -out:PATH                    Choose the artifact path
                               Build defaults to ./<working-directory-name>
  -o:MODE                      Set optimization
                                 none          Disable optimization (debug default)
                                 minimal       Minimal optimization (normal default)
                                 size          Optimize for smaller executables
                                 speed         Optimize for speed (publish default)
                                 aggressive    Enable more aggressive optimization
  -debug                       Generate debugger information with Thor locations
                               Native macOS enables tracking and AddressSanitizer
  --no-sanitize                Disable automatic debug AddressSanitizer
                               Explicit Odin sanitizer flags still apply

Allocation tracking: build, run, publish
  --track-allocations MODE     Choose tracking for native macOS executables
                                 auto     Basic with -debug (default)
                                 off      Disable allocation tracking
                                 basic    Report leaks and allocation violations
                                 trace    Also collect allocation call stacks (-debug)
                               Tests use Odin's test allocation tracker

Program arguments: run, test
  -- arguments                 Pass remaining arguments to the program/test runner

Application packaging: publish only
  --app-name NAME              Set the application name (default executable name)
  --app-id ID                  Set the reverse-domain application identifier
  --app-version VERSION        Set the version (default 0.1.0)
  --app-type TYPE              Choose how the application launches
                                 gui        Open without a terminal (default)
                                 console    Launch with a terminal
  --app-icon PATH              Choose a project-relative PNG or ICO icon
                               Default assets/icon.png or assets/icon.ico
  --app-resource PATH          Include a project resource file/directory (repeatable)
  --app-library PATH           Bundle a native library/plugin (repeatable)
  --publish-dir PATH           Choose the application package destination
                               Default working directory, or parent of -out:PATH

Project creation: new only
  --parent PATH                Choose the project parent (default working directory)
  --template PATH              Choose the starter .thor source
                               Default templates/main.thor in the Thor installation
  --open                       Open the new project in VS Code
  --no-open                    Create without opening VS Code (default)
  --gitignore                  Also create a .gitignore for build files and caches
  --odin PATH                  Set the Odin executable for the debug build task

Documentation: doc only
  -short                       Show abbreviated documentation
  -in-source-order             Preserve source declaration order
  -all-packages                Include imported packages
  -doc-format                  Export the .odin-doc interchange format
  -out:PATH                    Choose the documentation export path

Source cleanup: strip-semicolon only
  -keep-temp-files             Keep backups of edited project files
                               Original project sources are checked before editing

Android bundling: bundle only
  thor bundle android [directory] [options]
                               Bundle an existing Android output directory
  -android-keystore:PATH        Select the signing keystore
  -android-keystore-alias:NAME  Select the signing key
  -android-keystore-password:TEXT
                               Supply the keystore password
                               Omit to use the native packager prompt

Compiler and diagnostics: doc, strip-semicolon
  --odin PATH                  Select the Odin compiler (also THOR_ODIN)
  --diagnostic-format FORMAT   Choose text (default) or JSON diagnostics
  --overlay PATH               Read editor source replacements (doc only)

native_flags.name: file
native_flags.description: Select a self-contained file input. Thor detects file inputs automatically and accepts this spelling for compatibility.

native_flags.name: out
native_flags.description: Choose the output artifact path. For doc -doc-format this is the .odin-doc export base name; its extension is optional.

native_flags.name: o
native_flags.description:
Sets the optimization mode for compilation.
Available options:
	-o:none
	-o:minimal
	-o:size
	-o:speed
	-o:aggressive (use this with caution)
The default is -o:minimal. If -debug is set, the default is -o:none.

native_flags.name: show-timings
native_flags.description: Show Thor preparation, lowering and native compilation timings.

native_flags.name: show-more-timings
native_flags.description: Shows an advanced overview of the timings of different stages within the compiler in milliseconds.

native_flags.name: show-import-graph
native_flags.description: Shows dot graph text format of the import graph of a project.

native_flags.name: export-timings
native_flags.description:
Exports timings to one of a few formats. Requires `-show-timings` or `-show-more-timings`.
Available options:
	-export-timings:json   Exports compile time stats to JSON.
	-export-timings:csv    Exports compile time stats to CSV.

native_flags.name: export-timings-file
native_flags.description:
Specifies the filename for `-export-timings`.
Example: -export-timings-file:timings.json

native_flags.name: export-dependencies
native_flags.description: Export original source and resource dependencies. Formats are make (Makefile rules) and json (structured data). Requires -export-dependencies-file.

native_flags.name: export-dependencies-file
native_flags.description:
Specifies the filename for `-export-dependencies`.
Example: -export-dependencies-file:dependencies.d

native_flags.name: show-unused
native_flags.description: Shows unused package declarations within the current project.

native_flags.name: show-unused-with-location
native_flags.description: Shows unused package declarations within the current project with the declarations source location.

native_flags.name: show-system-calls
native_flags.description: Prints the whole command and arguments for calls to external tools like linker and assembler.

native_flags.name: thread-count
native_flags.description: Limit Thor worker threads and native compiler threads. Must be a positive integer.

native_flags.name: keep-temp-files
native_flags.description: Keeps the temporary files generated during stripping the unneeded semicolons from files.

native_flags.name: collection
native_flags.description:
Defines a library collection used for imports and foreign imports.
Example: -collection:shared=dir/to/shared
Usage in Code:
	import "shared:foo"
	foreign import lib "shared:libfoo.a"

native_flags.name: define
native_flags.description:
Defines a scalar boolean, integer or string as global constant.
Example: -define:SPAM=123
Usage in code:
	#config(SPAM, default_value)

native_flags.name: build-mode
native_flags.description:
Sets the build mode.
Available options:
	-build-mode:exe         Builds as an executable.
	-build-mode:test        Builds as an executable that executes tests.
	-build-mode:dll         Builds as a dynamically linked library.
	-build-mode:shared      Builds as a dynamically linked library.
	-build-mode:dynamic     Builds as a dynamically linked library.
	-build-mode:lib         Builds as a statically linked library.
	-build-mode:static      Builds as a statically linked library.
	-build-mode:obj         Builds as an object file.
	-build-mode:object      Builds as an object file.
	-build-mode:assembly    Builds as an assembly file.
	-build-mode:assembler   Builds as an assembly file.
	-build-mode:asm         Builds as an assembly file.
	-build-mode:llvm-ir     Builds as an LLVM IR file.
	-build-mode:llvm        Builds as an LLVM IR file.
run and publish require exe; test requires test. Other modes are available through build.
LLVM IR uses an output directory. Object and assembly modes can produce multiple units; use -use-single-module for one unit.
vet accepts test to check and correct test declarations without running tests.

native_flags.name: keep-executable
native_flags.description:
Keep the executable generated by `thor test` or `thor run` after running it. We clean it up by default.
If you build your program or test using `thor build`, the compiler does not automatically execute
the resulting program, and this option is not applicable.

native_flags.name: target
native_flags.description:
Sets the target for the executable to be built in.
Examples:
	-target:linux_amd64
	-target:windows_amd64
	-target:"?" for a list

native_flags.name: subtarget
native_flags.description:
[Darwin, Linux and Freestanding ARM32 only]
Available subtargets:
	-subtarget:iphone
	-subtarget:iphonesimulator
	-subtarget:android
	-subtarget:playdate

native_flags.name: debug
native_flags.description: Enables debug information, and defines the global constant ODIN_DEBUG to be 'true'. Sets -o:none by default.

native_flags.name: disable-assert
native_flags.description: Disables the code generation of the built-in run-time 'assert' procedure, and defines the global constant ODIN_DISABLE_ASSERT to be 'true'.

native_flags.name: no-bounds-check
native_flags.description: Disables bounds checking program wide.

native_flags.name: webkit-switch-workaround
native_flags.description:
Constrains 'typeid' values to 63 bits to avoid an OMG JIT crash in WebKit when running WASM builds.
Only needed for 'js_wasm32'/'js_wasm64p32' targets run in Safari/WebKit. See: https://github.com/odin-lang/Odin/issues/6810

native_flags.name: no-type-assert
native_flags.description: Disables type assertion checking program wide.

native_flags.name: lifetime-markers
native_flags.description:
Emits lifetime markers for named locals, so that locals from
non-overlapping scopes may reuse stack.
Requires '-o:size' or above; no effect with '-sanitize:address'.
Warning: this applies to every package in the build; using the address
of a local after the local's declaring scope ended can miscompile.

native_flags.name: no-thread-local
native_flags.description: Ignores @thread_local attribute, effectively treating the program as if it is single-threaded.

native_flags.name: no-dynamic-literals
native_flags.description: Disallow dynamic collection literals.

native_flags.name: dynamic-literals
native_flags.description: Enable dynamic collection literals.

native_flags.name: no-crt
native_flags.description: Disables automatic linking with the C Run Time.

native_flags.name: no-rpath
native_flags.description: Disables automatic addition of an rpath linked to the executable directory.

native_flags.name: no-entry-point
native_flags.description: Removes default requirement of an entry point (e.g. main procedure).

native_flags.name: no-escape-analysis
native_flags.description:
Disables the escape analysis of stack memory, except in files with '#+analysis escape'.
Where it is disabled, by this or by '#+analysis !escape', only returning the address of a local or similar is an error.
Cannot be used with -vet-nil-deref or -vet-uninitialized.

native_flags.name: no-atomic-analysis
native_flags.description:
Disables the analysis of atomic memory orderings, except in files with '#+analysis atomic'.
It warns where what is written with release ordering is only loaded with relaxed ordering, or the reverse.
Cannot be used with -vet-atomic-access.

native_flags.name: linker
native_flags.description:
Specify the linker to use.
Choices:
	default
	lld
	radlink
	mold

native_flags.name: use-separate-modules
native_flags.description:
The backend generates multiple build units which are then linked together.
This is the default behaviour for '-o:none' and '-o:minimal' builds.
Normally, a single build unit is generated for a standard project for '-o:speed' or '-o:size'.

native_flags.name: use-single-module
native_flags.description:
The backend generates only a single build unit.
This is the default behaviour for '-o:speed' or '-o:size'.

native_flags.name: no-threaded-checker
native_flags.description: Disables multithreading in the semantic checker stage.

native_flags.name: show-debug-messages
native_flags.description: Print native compiler debugging messages.

native_flags.name: did-you-mean-limit
native_flags.description:
Sets the maximum number of suggestions the compiler provides.
Must be an integer >0.
If not set, the default limit is 10.

native_flags.name: show-defineables
native_flags.description: Shows an overview of all the #config/#defined usages in the project.

native_flags.name: export-defineables
native_flags.description:
Exports an overview of all the #config/#defined usages in CSV format to the given file path.
Example: -export-defineables:defineables.csv

native_flags.name: ignore-unused-defineables
native_flags.description: Silence warning/error if a -define doesn't have at least one #config/#defined usage.

native_flags.name: vet
native_flags.description: Enable Odin’s bundled native vet checks. These policies report errors.

native_flags.name: vet-unused
native_flags.description: Checks for unused declarations (variables and imports).

native_flags.name: vet-unused-variables
native_flags.description: Checks for unused variable declarations.

native_flags.name: vet-unused-procedures
native_flags.description:
Checks for unused procedures.
Must be used with -vet-packages or specified on a per file with +vet tags.

native_flags.name: vet-unused-imports
native_flags.description: Checks for unused import declarations.

native_flags.name: vet-shadowing
native_flags.description: Checks for variable shadowing within procedures.

native_flags.name: vet-using-stmt
native_flags.description:
Checks for the use of 'using' as a statement.
'using' is considered bad practice outside of immediate refactoring.

native_flags.name: vet-using-param
native_flags.description:
Checks for the use of 'using' on procedure parameters.
'using' is considered bad practice outside of immediate refactoring.

native_flags.name: vet-style
native_flags.description:
Errs on missing trailing commas followed by a newline.
Errs on deprecated syntax.
Does not err on unneeded tokens (unlike -strict-style).

native_flags.name: vet-semicolon
native_flags.description: Errs on unneeded semicolons.

native_flags.name: vet-cast
native_flags.description: Errs on casting a value to its own type or using `transmute` rather than `cast`.

native_flags.name: vet-tabs
native_flags.description: Errs when the use of tabs has not been used for indentation.

native_flags.name: vet-when-shadowing
native_flags.description: Checks for declarations within a global 'when' that shadow a builtin or package-level name.

native_flags.name: vet-nil-deref
native_flags.description:
Errs on dereferencing a pointer, or calling a procedure value, which is nil on every path reaching it.
A pointer made through an explicit conversion to 'rawptr' or 'uintptr', or a 'transmute', is never assumed to be nil.

native_flags.name: vet-uninitialized
native_flags.description:
Errs on reading a variable declared with '---', or a part of it, before anything is stored in it on every path reaching it.
Taking its address, e.g. to pass it to a procedure which fills it in, counts as storing into it.

native_flags.name: vet-atomic-access
native_flags.description: Errs on a plain read of a variable or field which is accessed atomically elsewhere, except in procedures which take a lock.

native_flags.name: vet-packages
native_flags.description:
Sets which packages by name will be vetted.
Files with specific +vet tags will not be ignored if they are not in the packages set.

native_flags.name: custom-attribute
native_flags.description:
Add a custom attribute which will be ignored if it is unknown.
This can be used with metaprogramming tools.
Examples:
	-custom-attribute:my_tag
	-custom-attribute:my_tag,the_other_thing
	-custom-attribute:my_tag -custom-attribute:the_other_thing

native_flags.name: ignore-unknown-attributes
native_flags.description:
Ignores unknown attributes.
This can be used with metaprogramming tools.

native_flags.name: extra-linker-flags
native_flags.description: Adds extra linker specific flags in a string.

native_flags.name: extra-assembler-flags
native_flags.description: Adds extra assembler specific flags in a string.

native_flags.name: microarch
native_flags.description:
Specifies the specific micro-architecture for the build in a string.
Examples:
	-microarch:sandybridge
	-microarch:native
	-microarch:"?" for a list

native_flags.name: target-features
native_flags.description:
Specifies CPU features to enable on top of the enabled features implied by -microarch.
Examples:
	-target-features:atomics
	-target-features:"sse2,aes"
	-target-features:"?" for a list

native_flags.name: strict-target-features
native_flags.description:
Makes @(enable_target_features="...") behave the same way as @(require_target_features="...").
This enforces that all generated code uses features supported by the combination of -target, -microarch, and -target-features.

native_flags.name: minimum-os-version
native_flags.description:
Sets the minimum OS version targeted by the application.
Default: -minimum-os-version:11.0.0
Only used when target is Darwin or subtarget is Android, if given, linking mismatched versions will emit a warning.

native_flags.name: reloc-mode
native_flags.description:
Specifies the reloc mode.
Available options:
	-reloc-mode:default
	-reloc-mode:static
	-reloc-mode:pic
	-reloc-mode:dynamic-no-pic

native_flags.name: stack-protector
native_flags.description:
Specifies the stack protector.
Available options:
	-stack-protector:none
	-stack-protector:base
	-stack-protector:all
	-stack-protector:strong

native_flags.name: disable-red-zone
native_flags.description: Disables red zone on a supported freestanding target.

native_flags.name: disable-unwind
native_flags.description: Disable unwind information.

native_flags.name: disallow-do
native_flags.description: Disallows the 'do' keyword in the project.

native_flags.name: default-to-nil-allocator
native_flags.description: Sets the default allocator to be the nil_allocator, an allocator which does nothing.

native_flags.name: default-to-panic-allocator
native_flags.description: Sets the default allocator to be the panic_allocator, an allocator which calls panic() on any allocation attempt.

native_flags.name: strict-style
native_flags.description:
This enforces parts of same style as the Odin compiler, prefer '-vet-style -vet-semicolon' if you do not want to match it exactly.

Errs on unneeded tokens, such as unneeded semicolons.
Errs on missing trailing commas followed by a newline.
Errs on deprecated syntax.
Errs when the attached-brace style is not adhered to (also known as 1TBS).
Errs when 'case' labels are not in the same column as the associated 'switch' token.

native_flags.name: strict-style-packages
native_flags.description:
Sets which packages by name will be checked against with '-strict-style'.
Files with specific +vet tags will not be ignored if they are not in the packages set.

native_flags.name: foreign-error-procedures
native_flags.description: States that the error procedures used in the runtime are defined in a separate translation unit.

native_flags.name: no-rtti
native_flags.description: Disable runtime type information where the target permits it.

native_flags.name: disallow-rtti
native_flags.description: Compatibility spelling for -no-rtti.

native_flags.name: dynamic-map-calls
native_flags.description: Uses dynamic map calls to minimize code generation at the cost of runtime execution.

native_flags.name: obfuscate-source-code-locations
native_flags.description: Compatibility spelling for -source-code-locations:obfuscated.

native_flags.name: source-code-locations
native_flags.description:
Processes the file and procedure strings, and line and column numbers, stored with a 'runtime.Source_Code_Location' value.
Available options:
	-source-code-locations:normal
	-source-code-locations:obfuscated
	-source-code-locations:filename
	-source-code-locations:none
The default is -source-code-locations:normal.

native_flags.name: short
native_flags.description: Shows shortened documentation for the packages.

native_flags.name: in-source-order
native_flags.description: Shows documentation for the packages in source order within each file.

native_flags.name: all-packages
native_flags.description: Include imported packages in documentation and test discovery. With vet, use -build-mode:test.

native_flags.name: doc-format
native_flags.description: Generates documentation as the .odin-doc format (useful for external tooling).

native_flags.name: ignore-warnings
native_flags.description: Ignores warning messages.

native_flags.name: warnings-as-errors
native_flags.description: Treats warning messages as error messages.

native_flags.name: terse-errors
native_flags.description: Prints a terse error message without showing the code on that line and the location in that line.

native_flags.name: verbose-errors
native_flags.description: Request additional compiler diagnostic detail.

native_flags.name: json-errors
native_flags.description: Prints the error messages as json to stderr.

native_flags.name: error-pos-style
native_flags.description:
Available options:
	-error-pos-style:unix      file/path:45:3:
	-error-pos-style:thor      file/path(45:3)
	-error-pos-style:default   (Defaults to 'odin'.)

native_flags.name: max-error-count
native_flags.description:
Sets the maximum number of errors that can be displayed before the compiler terminates.
Must be an integer >0.
If not set, the default max error count is 36.

native_flags.name: min-link-libs
native_flags.description:
If set, the number of linked libraries will be minimized to prevent duplications.
This is useful for so called "dumb" linkers compared to "smart" linkers.

native_flags.name: export-linked-libs-file
native_flags.description: Write the linked native library paths to a file.

native_flags.name: print-linker-flags
native_flags.description: Prints the all of the flags/arguments that will be passed to the linker.

native_flags.name: integer-division-by-zero
native_flags.description:
Specifies the default behaviour for integer division by zero.
Available Options:
	-integer-division-by-zero:trap        Trap on division/modulo/remainder by zero
	-integer-division-by-zero:zero        x/0 == 0 and x%0 == x and x%%0 == x
	-integer-division-by-zero:self        x/0 == x and x%0 == 0 and x%%0 == 0
	-integer-division-by-zero:all-bits    x/0 == ~T(0) and x%0 == x and x%%0 == x

native_flags.name: build-diagnostics
native_flags.description: Emit native compiler build diagnostics.

native_flags.name: bedrock
native_flags.description:
Disables numerous features. List of disabled features:
	`map` types
	128-bit integer types
	runtime type information (-no-rtti)
	non-constant global variables (-disable-non-constant-globals)
	@(init) @(fini) (-disable-init-fini)
	Anything Objective-C related
	The default paths to the library collections 'core' and 'vendor'

native_flags.name: disable-non-constant-globals
native_flags.description: Disables any global variables which are not initialized with global constants

native_flags.name: disable-init-fini
native_flags.description: Disables the ability to use @(init) and @(fini) procedures

native_flags.name: internal-fast-isel
native_flags.description: Use the experimental LLVM fast instruction selector. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-ignore-lazy
native_flags.description: Disable lazy procedure generation in the native compiler. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-ignore-llvm-build
native_flags.description: Skip LLVM module construction in the native compiler. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-ignore-panic
native_flags.description: Ignore native panic paths; intended for compiler investigations only. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-module-per-file
native_flags.description: Generate a separate LLVM module for each input file. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-cached
native_flags.description: Enable the native compiler’s experimental object caching. This is separate from Thor’s compile-time result cache. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-no-inline
native_flags.description: Disable native procedure inlining for compiler investigations. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-by-value
native_flags.description: Use the experimental native by-value calling convention. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-weak-monomorphization
native_flags.description: Use weak linkage for native polymorphic procedure specializations. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-ignore-llvm-verification
native_flags.description: Skip verification of generated LLVM modules. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-llvm-no-sroa
native_flags.description: Disable LLVM scalar replacement of aggregate storage. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-enable-rvo
native_flags.description: Enable experimental native return-value optimization. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-global-entity-graph
native_flags.description: Use the native compiler’s experimental global entity graph. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-shuffle-global-entities
native_flags.description: Shuffle native global entities using the supplied integer seed. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: internal-check-global-edges
native_flags.description: Validate edges in the native compiler’s global entity graph. Compiler-development option; availability and behavior depend on the selected toolchain.

native_flags.name: sanitize
native_flags.description:
Enables sanitization analysis.
Available options:
	-sanitize:address
	-sanitize:memory
	-sanitize:thread

native_flags.name: lto
native_flags.description:
States that the project is to be build with link-time optimizations.
This also enables '-use-separate-modules' (if not already set) and `-linker:lld
Choices:
	thin       (one module per package)
	thin-files (one module file)

native_flags.name: ignore-vs-search
native_flags.description: Skip Visual Studio library-path discovery on Windows.

native_flags.name: resource
native_flags.description: Select a Windows resource file.

native_flags.name: pdb-name
native_flags.description: Choose the Windows debugging database filename.

native_flags.name: subsystem
native_flags.description: Select the Windows subsystem. Values are console and windows.

native_flags.name: android-keystore
native_flags.description: Specifies the keystore file to use to sign the apk.

native_flags.name: android-keystore-alias
native_flags.description:
Specifies the key alias to use when signing the apk
Can be omitted if the keystore only contains one key

native_flags.name: android-keystore-password
native_flags.description:
Sets the password to use to unlock the keystore
If this is omitted, the terminal will prompt you to provide it.

native_flags.name: windows-sdk-root
native_flags.description:
Path to the root directory of the Windows SDK for cross-linking.
Requires '-linker:lld' flag and 'lld-link' installation.
Example: -windows-sdk-root:~/windows-sdk
